blocks.zh: 核心概念：HVAC 設備的六大任務
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Six Duties of HVAC Equipment

blocks.zh: HVAC 設備在 GMP 環境中不只是「吹冷氣」，它承擔六項關鍵任務：
blocks.en: In a GMP environment, HVAC equipment does much more than "blow cold air". It performs six key duties:

blocks.zh: 溫度控制——維持製程和人員舒適所需溫度
blocks.en: Temperature control - maintaining the temperature needed for the process and for personnel comfort

blocks.zh: 壓差維持——透過 DP（Differential Pressure，壓差）關係防止交叉污染
blocks.en: Pressure differential maintenance - preventing cross-contamination through DP (Differential Pressure) relationships

blocks.zh: 空氣潔淨——最小化 HVAC 系統本身帶入的微粒污染
blocks.en: Air cleanliness - minimizing the particulate contamination introduced by the HVAC system itself

blocks.zh: 新風補充——提供通風和壓差所需的外氣
blocks.en: Fresh air supply - providing the outside air needed for ventilation and pressurization

blocks.zh: 濕度調節——控制相對濕度（RH, Relative Humidity）
blocks.en: Humidity control - controlling relative humidity (RH)

blocks.zh: 換氣量——維持潔淨等級和恢復率（Recovery Rate）
blocks.en: Air change rate - maintaining the cleanliness classification and recovery rate

blocks.zh: 核心概念：什麼是 AHU？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Is an AHU?

blocks.zh: AHU（Air Handling Unit，空調箱）是一個整合式設備包，包含：
blocks.en: An AHU (Air Handling Unit) is an integrated equipment package that includes:

blocks.zh: 金屬外殼箱體（Casing Box）
blocks.en: A metal casing box

blocks.zh: 風機或鼓風機（Fan/Blower）
blocks.en: A fan or blower

blocks.zh: 加熱和冷卻盤管（Heating/Cooling Coils）
blocks.en: Heating and cooling coils

blocks.zh: 空氣過濾器（Air Filtration）
blocks.en: Air filtration

blocks.zh: 維護用檢修門/面板（Access Doors/Panels）
blocks.en: Access doors/panels for maintenance

blocks.zh: AHU 就像是 HVAC 系統的「心臟」，將空氣調節到需要的狀態後，透過風管系統輸送到各個房間。
blocks.en: The AHU is the "heart" of the HVAC system: it conditions the air and then delivers it through the ductwork to each room.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：AHU 就像一台多功能淨水器
blocks.en: Analogy: An AHU Is Like a Multi-Function Water Purifier

blocks.zh: 想像一台大型淨水器：水進來先過濾（空氣過濾），然後加熱或冷卻到適當溫度（盤管），再用泵浦（風機）把處理好的水送到各個水龍頭（房間）。AHU 對空氣做的事情和淨水器對水做的事情完全一樣——過濾、調溫、調濕、加壓輸送。
blocks.en: Picture a large water purifier: water comes in and is filtered first (air filtration), then heated or cooled to the right temperature (coils), and a pump (fan) sends the treated water to each tap (room). An AHU does to air exactly what the purifier does to water: filter, adjust temperature, adjust humidity and pressurize for delivery.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 特別強調 HVAC 系統要「最小化自身帶入的微粒污染」？HVAC 系統本身可能產生哪些污染？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE specifically stress that an HVAC system should "minimize the particulate contamination it introduces itself"? What kinds of contamination can an HVAC system generate?

blocks.zh: AHU 的檢修門/面板（Access Doors）為什麼對 GMP 很重要？如果維護困難會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why are the AHU access doors/panels important for GMP? What are the consequences if maintenance is difficult?

blocks.zh: 8.1.3-8.1.6 Fan, Mixing Box, Energy Recovery, Fume Exhaust（風機、混合箱、能量回收、排氣系統）
blocks.en: 8.1.3-8.1.6 Fan, Mixing Box, Energy Recovery, Fume Exhaust

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Supply Fan vs. Return Fan
blocks.en: Core Concept: Supply Fan vs. Return Fan

blocks.zh: 送風機（Supply Fan）提供空氣流動的動力，將調節後的空氣送到各房間。回風機（Return Fan）則獨立管理回風側的壓力和流量。
blocks.en: The Supply Fan provides the motive force for airflow and sends conditioned air to each room. The Return Fan manages the pressure and flow on the return side independently.

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 Return Fan？在大型再循環系統中，如果只靠 Supply Fan，回風側的壓力和流量無法獨立調節。特別是當系統有變風量控制器（VAV）時，回風機可以獨立應對房間壓差變化。
blocks.en: Why is a Return Fan needed? In a large recirculated system, relying on the Supply Fan alone means the return-side pressure and flow cannot be adjusted independently. This matters especially when the system has variable air volume (VAV) controllers, because the return fan can respond independently to changes in room pressure differentials.

blocks.zh: Economizer Cycle（節能器循環）：當室外空氣的溫濕度條件接近需要的送風條件時，可以增加外氣比例，減少冷卻能耗——直接用「免費冷氣」。但此模式通常只用於非壓差控制區域（辦公室、倉庫）。
blocks.en: Economizer Cycle: when the outdoor air temperature and humidity are close to the required supply conditions, the proportion of outside air can be increased to reduce cooling energy, in effect using "free cooling". However, this mode is normally used only in areas without pressure control (offices, warehouses).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：混合箱的溫度分層風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Risk of Temperature Stratification in the Mixing Box

blocks.zh: 在寒冷環境中，混合箱內的冷外氣和暖回風可能無法均勻混合，形成溫度分層（Temperature Stratification）：
blocks.en: In cold climates, the cold outside air and warm return air in the mixing box may not mix evenly, resulting in Temperature Stratification:

blocks.zh: 上層暖空氣 + 下層冷空氣 → 溫度感測器讀數不準確
blocks.en: Warm air above + cold air below → inaccurate temperature sensor readings

blocks.zh: 局部低溫 → 加熱盤管局部結凍（即使是蒸汽盤管也可能結凍！）
blocks.en: Localized low temperature → local freezing of the heating coil (even steam coils can freeze!)

blocks.zh: 解決方案：安裝 Air Blender（空氣混合器），利用渦流強制混合
blocks.en: Solution: install an Air Blender, which forces mixing through turbulence

blocks.zh: 這在台灣較少遇到，但如果你的 CDMO 在北美或歐洲有工廠，冬季防凍設計是關鍵。
blocks.en: This is seldom encountered in Taiwan, but if your CDMO has sites in North America or Europe, winter freeze protection design is critical.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：能量回收盤管就像熱交換型抽油煙機
blocks.en: Analogy: An Energy Recovery Coil Is Like a Heat-Exchange Range Hood

blocks.zh: 在全新風系統中，你花了大量能源把室外空氣調節到 22°C / 45% RH，然後全部排出去——就像把洗好的熱水直接倒掉。Energy Recovery Coil（能量回收盤管）就像家用熱交換型全熱交換器（HRV/ERV），用排出的空氣先「預熱」或「預冷」進來的新空氣，回收 50-80% 的能量。
blocks.en: In a once-through system, you spend a great deal of energy conditioning outdoor air to 22°C / 45% RH and then exhaust all of it, like pouring freshly heated water straight down the drain. An Energy Recovery Coil works like a household total heat exchanger (HRV/ERV): the exhaust air first "pre-heats" or "pre-cools" the incoming fresh air, recovering 50-80% of the energy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：排氣系統的 Re-entrainment 風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Re-entrainment Risk of Exhaust Systems

blocks.zh: Re-entrainment（再吸入）是排氣系統設計中最容易被忽略的風險——排出的污染空氣被其他 HVAC 系統的進氣口吸回來。ISPE 要求排氣要排到「安全距離」，實務上意味著：
blocks.en: Re-entrainment is the most easily overlooked risk in exhaust system design: contaminated exhaust air is drawn back in through the air intakes of other HVAC systems. ISPE requires that exhaust be discharged to a "safe distance", which in practice means:

blocks.zh: 排氣口與進氣口之間有足夠的距離和高度差
blocks.en: Sufficient distance and height difference between exhaust outlets and air intakes

blocks.zh: 排氣口應在屋頂以上，且遠離新風口
blocks.en: Exhaust outlets should be above the roof line and away from fresh air intakes

blocks.zh: 考慮主導風向的影響
blocks.en: Consider the influence of the prevailing wind direction

blocks.zh: 8.1.7 Heating Coil（加熱盤管）
blocks.en: 8.1.7 Heating Coil

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Reheat 的邏輯——先冷再熱
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of Reheat - Cool First, Then Heat

blocks.zh: 「先冷卻再加熱」聽起來很浪費，但想像一下：你洗完澡後浴室鏡子都是霧氣（高濕度），你用除濕機（冷卻盤管）降溫把水分凝結出來，但空氣變太冷了。這時用 Reheat Coil 再加熱，就能得到溫暖又乾燥的空氣。
blocks.en: "Cooling first and then heating" sounds wasteful, but think of it this way: after a shower the bathroom mirror is fogged up (high humidity). A dehumidifier (cooling coil) cools the air and condenses out the moisture, but the air becomes too cold. A Reheat Coil then warms it again, giving warm, dry air.

blocks.zh: 藥廠的許多製程（如吸入劑、乾粉產品）對濕度要求嚴格，「先冷後熱」是最簡單的除濕方式。
blocks.en: Many pharmaceutical processes (such as inhalation and dry powder products) have strict humidity requirements, and "cool first, then heat" is the simplest way to dehumidify.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Preheat Coil 防凍設計
blocks.en: Key Point: Freeze Protection Design for the Preheat Coil

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別警告：如果進入預熱盤管的空氣溫度低於冰點，必須採取防凍措施。即使是蒸汽盤管（通常被認為不會凍）也可能因為控制閥故障或蒸汽壓力下降而在局部結凍。常見防凍方法包括：
blocks.en: ISPE specifically warns that if the air entering the preheat coil can be below freezing, freeze protection measures must be taken. Even steam coils (usually considered freeze-proof) can freeze locally because of a control valve failure or a drop in steam pressure. Common freeze protection methods include:

blocks.zh: 使用乙二醇循環而非純水
blocks.en: Using circulating glycol rather than plain water

blocks.zh: 安裝 Freezestat（防凍溫控開關）
blocks.en: Installing a Freezestat (freeze protection thermostat)

blocks.zh: 確保蒸汽盤管有足夠的凝結水排放能力
blocks.en: Ensuring the steam coil has sufficient condensate drainage capacity

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三種加熱盤管的角色
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Roles of Heating Coils

blocks.zh: 加熱盤管看似簡單，但在 HVAC 系統中有三種不同角色：
blocks.en: Heating coils look simple, but they play three different roles in an HVAC system:

blocks.zh: 加熱介質可以是蒸汽（Steam）、熱水（Hot Water）、乙二醇（Glycol）、熱冷媒氣體，或電加熱元件。
blocks.en: The heating medium can be steam, hot water, glycol, hot refrigerant gas, or electric heating elements.

blocks.zh: 8.1.8 Cooling Coil（冷卻盤管）
blocks.en: 8.1.8 Cooling Coil

blocks.zh: 核心概念：冷卻盤管的雙重任務
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual Duty of the Cooling Coil

blocks.zh: Cooling Coil（冷卻盤管）同時處理兩種熱負荷：
blocks.en: A Cooling Coil handles two kinds of heat load at the same time:

blocks.zh: Sensible Heat（顯熱）：降低空氣溫度
blocks.en: Sensible Heat: lowering the air temperature

blocks.zh: Latent Heat（潛熱）：將水蒸氣凝結成液態水，降低濕度
blocks.en: Latent Heat: condensing water vapor into liquid water, which lowers the humidity

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼冷卻盤管是 AHU 中最常見的除濕方式。關鍵設計議題：
blocks.en: This is why the cooling coil is the most common means of dehumidification in an AHU. Key design issues:

blocks.zh: Air Velocity（風速）：過快會把凝結水滴吹向下游
blocks.en: Air Velocity: if too high, it blows condensed water droplets downstream

blocks.zh: Drainage（排水）：凝結水必須順暢排出，否則滋生微生物
blocks.en: Drainage: condensate must drain freely, otherwise microorganisms will grow

blocks.zh: Mist Eliminator（除霧器）：攔截被氣流帶走的水滴
blocks.en: Mist Eliminator: intercepts water droplets carried by the airflow

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Bypass Damper 的兩面刃
blocks.en: Key Point: The Double-Edged Sword of the Bypass Damper

blocks.zh: 冷卻盤管壓降大，不冷卻時用 Bypass Damper 旁通可以節省風機能耗。但 ISPE 警告：需要最大冷卻時，旁通風門可能發生未調節空氣洩漏——部分空氣繞過盤管直接進入送風系統，導致溫度和濕度控制失敗。
blocks.en: A cooling coil has a high pressure drop, so bypassing it with a Bypass Damper when no cooling is needed saves fan energy. ISPE warns, however, that when maximum cooling is required the bypass damper may allow uncontrolled air leakage: some air goes around the coil and directly into the supply system, causing temperature and humidity control to fail.

blocks.zh: 在 GMP 環境中，建議優先考慮：不使用 Bypass Damper，或確保其密封性能經過確認。
blocks.en: In a GMP environment, the preferred approach is either not to use a Bypass Damper or to ensure its sealing performance has been qualified.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Re-cool Coil 的結冰風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Icing Risk of the Re-cool Coil

blocks.zh: Re-cool Coil（再冷卻盤管）運行在冰水溫度以下（使用冷媒或低溫鹽水），盤管內部溫度可能低於冰點，導致盤管表面結冰。解決方案是交替旁通/除冰循環（Alternation Bypass/De-icing Scheme）——兩組盤管輪流工作，一組除冰時另一組繼續冷卻。
blocks.en: A Re-cool Coil operates below chilled water temperature (using refrigerant or low-temperature brine), so the temperature inside the coil may fall below freezing and ice can form on the coil surface. The solution is an Alternation Bypass/De-icing Scheme: two coil banks work in turn, so while one is de-icing the other continues cooling.

blocks.zh: 一間乾粉吸入劑（DPI）生產間要求 RH < 25%，冷卻盤管的除濕能力是否足夠？什麼時候需要加裝乾燥劑除濕器（Desiccant Dehumidifier）？
blocks.en: A dry powder inhaler (DPI) production room requires RH < 25%. Is the dehumidification capacity of a cooling coil sufficient? When does a Desiccant Dehumidifier need to be added?

blocks.zh: 冷卻盤管的凝結水排水如果堵塞，對 GMP 合規性有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the cooling coil condensate drain becomes blocked, what is the impact on GMP compliance?

blocks.zh: 8.1.9 Humidifier（加濕器）
blocks.en: 8.1.9 Humidifier

blocks.zh: 核心概念：加濕器的水源選擇——GMP 的關鍵決策
blocks.en: Core Concept: Humidifier Water Source - A Key GMP Decision

blocks.zh: 加濕器向空氣中噴入水蒸氣或水霧，水源品質直接影響產品安全。ISPE 列出的水源選項（從最嚴格到最寬鬆）：
blocks.en: A humidifier injects water vapor or water mist into the air, so water source quality directly affects product safety. The water source options listed by ISPE (from most to least stringent):

blocks.zh: Clean Steam（潔淨蒸汽）：由 USP 純化水或 WFI 產生。ISPE 認為用於 HVAC 加濕是浪費（wasteful）
blocks.en: Clean Steam: generated from USP purified water or WFI. ISPE considers its use for HVAC humidification wasteful

blocks.zh: Re-boiler 蒸汽：用銅/黃銅/不鏽鋼再沸器，以適當品質的水為原料，被工廠蒸汽加熱產生。這是 ISPE 推薦的折衷方案
blocks.en: Re-boiler steam: generated in a copper/brass/stainless steel re-boiler, using water of appropriate quality as feed and heated by plant steam. This is the compromise ISPE recommends

blocks.zh: 無揮發性添加劑的工廠蒸汽：可直接用於製藥生產區
blocks.en: Plant steam without volatile additives: can be used directly in pharmaceutical production areas

blocks.zh: 含添加劑的工廠蒸汽（Plant Steam）：含胺類防腐劑，只能用於非生產區
blocks.en: Plant Steam with additives: contains amine-based inhibitors and may be used only in non-production areas

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：蒸汽品質就像飲水標準
blocks.en: Analogy: Steam Quality Is Like Drinking Water Standards

blocks.zh: 想像你要在餐廳噴水霧降溫：用自來水就好，不需要用瓶裝礦泉水。但如果你是在手術室噴水霧，至少要用 RO 水。用 WFI 蒸汽做 HVAC 加濕，就像拿著 Evian 礦泉水洗地板——品質夠好但實在浪費。ISPE 建議用 Re-boiler 產生的蒸汽，就像在手術室用品質足夠的 RO 水——既安全又經濟。
blocks.en: Imagine spraying a water mist to cool a restaurant: tap water is fine, and there is no need for bottled mineral water. But in an operating theatre you would need at least RO water. Using WFI steam for HVAC humidification is like washing the floor with Evian: the quality is more than good enough, but it is a waste. ISPE recommends steam from a re-boiler, which is like using RO water of sufficient quality in the operating theatre: safe and economical.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：加濕器停用時的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Microbial Risk When the Humidifier Is Not in Use

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別提醒：加濕器不使用時，殘留水分系統如果沒有適當保護，極容易滋生細菌。這在季節性使用的加濕器上尤其危險——冬天用完，春夏閒置的管路變成微生物培養皿。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically points out that when a humidifier is not in use, residual water in the system readily supports bacterial growth unless it is properly protected. This is especially dangerous for seasonally used humidifiers: after use in winter, the idle piping through spring and summer becomes a microbial culture dish.

blocks.zh: 最佳做法：不使用時排空系統、定期消毒、或使用 SIP（Steam In Place）設計。
blocks.en: Best practice: drain the system when not in use, disinfect it regularly, or use a SIP (Steam In Place) design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：風管內加濕的上限——80% RH
blocks.en: Key Point: The In-Duct Humidification Limit - 80% RH

blocks.zh: 風管內的相對濕度不能接近飽和點，否則會在風管壁面、過濾器上形成凝結水，導致：
blocks.en: The relative humidity in a duct must not approach the saturation point, otherwise condensation forms on duct walls and filters, leading to:

blocks.zh: 金屬風管腐蝕（所以加濕器下游要用不鏽鋼風管）
blocks.en: Corrosion of metal ductwork (so stainless steel ductwork should be used downstream of the humidifier)

blocks.zh: 過濾器吸水後效率降低且可能滋生微生物
blocks.en: Reduced filter efficiency once the filter absorbs water, and possible microbial growth

blocks.zh: 常見設計上限：80% RH
blocks.en: A common design upper limit: 80% RH

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 發現冬季送風濕度不足（RH < 20%），考慮安裝加濕器。關鍵決策點：
blocks.en: A CDMO finds the supply air humidity insufficient in winter (RH < 20%) and is considering installing a humidifier. Key decision points:

blocks.zh: 水源選擇：工廠是否有不含胺類的蒸汽？是否需要 Re-boiler？
blocks.en: Water source: does the site have amine-free steam? Is a Re-boiler needed?

blocks.zh: 安裝位置：在 AHU 內冷卻盤管上游，還是在風管內？
blocks.en: Installation location: inside the AHU upstream of the cooling coil, or in the duct?

blocks.zh: 下游風管材質：加濕器後至少 3-5 公尺改用焊接密封的不鏽鋼風管
blocks.en: Downstream duct material: use welded, sealed stainless steel ductwork for at least 3-5 meters after the humidifier

blocks.zh: 閒置管理：夏季不用時的消毒和排空 SOP
blocks.en: Idle management: an SOP for disinfection and draining when not in use in summer

blocks.zh: 8.1.10 Dehumidifier（除濕器）
blocks.en: 8.1.10 Dehumidifier

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種除濕方式的臨界點
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Crossover Point Between Two Dehumidification Methods

blocks.zh: HVAC 系統有兩種除濕方式，選擇取決於目標 RH：
blocks.en: An HVAC system has two ways to dehumidify, and the choice depends on the target RH:

blocks.zh: 冷卻盤管除濕：經濟實惠，但只能將 RH 降到約 30-40%。原理：空氣冷卻到露點以下，水分凝結在盤管上
blocks.en: Cooling coil dehumidification: economical, but can only bring RH down to about 30-40%. Principle: the air is cooled below its dew point and the moisture condenses on the coil

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑除濕（Desiccant）：可將 RH 降到 10% 以下。原理：吸附劑（如矽膠、分子篩）吸收空氣中的水分，然後用熱空氣再生
blocks.en: Desiccant dehumidification: can bring RH below 10%. Principle: an adsorbent (such as silica gel or molecular sieve) absorbs moisture from the air and is then regenerated with hot air

blocks.zh: 最佳實務是兩者串聯：冷卻盤管先去除大部分水分（低成本），再用乾燥劑做精密除濕。
blocks.en: Best practice is to use both in series: the cooling coil first removes most of the moisture (low cost), then the desiccant provides precision dehumidification.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Desiccant Dehumidifier 的三大注意事項
blocks.en: Key Point: Three Things to Watch with a Desiccant Dehumidifier

blocks.zh: 出風溫度升高：乾燥劑吸附水分會釋放熱量，出風比進風更熱更乾→通常需要 Re-cool Coil
blocks.en: Higher outlet air temperature: adsorption of moisture by the desiccant releases heat, so the outlet air is hotter and drier than the inlet air → a Re-cool Coil is usually needed

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑保護：液態水滴會損壞乾燥劑，所以上游冷卻盤管需要 Mist Eliminator
blocks.en: Desiccant protection: liquid water droplets will damage the desiccant, so the upstream cooling coil needs a Mist Eliminator

blocks.zh: 閒置時仍需再生：某些乾燥劑在不使用時也需要保持再生狀態，否則會損壞
blocks.en: Regeneration while idle: some desiccants must be kept in regeneration even when not in use, otherwise they will be damaged

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：設計和調試乾燥劑除濕器的控制系統需要專門的專業知識，應諮詢設備製造商。
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that designing and commissioning the control system of a desiccant dehumidifier requires specialist expertise, and the equipment manufacturer should be consulted.

blocks.zh: 一間生產吸入劑乾粉（DPI）的房間要求 RH < 15%，只用冷卻盤管除濕可以嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A room producing dry powder inhalers (DPI) requires RH < 15%. Is a cooling coil alone enough for dehumidification? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 建議乾燥劑除濕器設在冷卻盤管下游，而不是上游？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE recommend placing the desiccant dehumidifier downstream of the cooling coil rather than upstream?

blocks.zh: 8.1.11 Air Filtration（空氣過濾）
blocks.en: 8.1.11 Air Filtration

blocks.zh: 核心概念：空氣過濾的三道防線
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Lines of Defense in Air Filtration

blocks.zh: HVAC 空氣過濾系統採用層層保護的策略：
blocks.en: The HVAC air filtration system uses a layered protection strategy:

blocks.zh: Pre-filter（預過濾器）：低效率的粗塵過濾，位於盤管上游，保護盤管不被灰塵堵塞
blocks.en: Pre-filter: low-efficiency coarse dust filter, located upstream of the coils to protect them from dust clogging

blocks.zh: Intermediate Filter（中效過濾器）：中高效率，進一步減少微粒
blocks.en: Intermediate Filter: medium-to-high efficiency, further reducing particulates

blocks.zh: Final Filter（終端過濾器）：95% DOP 或 HEPA（High Efficiency Particulate Air），確保送風風管內的空氣品質
blocks.en: Final Filter: 95% DOP or HEPA (High Efficiency Particulate Air), ensuring the quality of the air in the supply ductwork

blocks.zh: Terminal HEPA（末端 HEPA）：安裝在天花板上的最後一道過濾，確保進入房間的空氣達到潔淨等級
blocks.en: Terminal HEPA: the last filtration stage, installed in the ceiling, ensuring the air entering the room meets the cleanliness classification

blocks.zh: 每一層都在保護下一層——延長壽命、降低更換成本、防止差異性遮蔽（Differential Blinding）。
blocks.en: Each layer protects the next: extending its life, lowering replacement cost and preventing Differential Blinding.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：過濾系統就像多層淨水
blocks.en: Analogy: A Filtration System Is Like Multi-Stage Water Purification

blocks.zh: 想像家用淨水系統：PP 棉濾芯（Pre-filter）擋住大顆粒 → 活性碳（Intermediate）去除異味 → RO 膜（Final Filter）去除微量雜質。每一層都在保護更精密的下一層。如果你跳過 PP 棉直接用 RO 膜，膜會快速堵塞、成本暴增。
blocks.en: Think of a household water purifier: the PP cotton cartridge (Pre-filter) stops large particles → activated carbon (Intermediate) removes odors → the RO membrane (Final Filter) removes trace impurities. Each layer protects the finer one after it. If you skip the PP cotton and go straight to the RO membrane, the membrane clogs quickly and costs soar.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：活性碳過濾器的特殊用途
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Uses of Activated Carbon Filters

blocks.zh: ISPE 提到活性碳過濾器用於吸收氣味和揮發性有機物（VOC）。在 CDMO 環境中，這可能用於：
blocks.en: ISPE mentions that activated carbon filters are used to absorb odors and volatile organic compounds (VOCs). In a CDMO environment, this might be used to:

blocks.zh: 處理溶劑型製程（如流化床造粒使用的異丙醇、乙醇）的排氣
blocks.en: Treat exhaust from solvent-based processes (such as the isopropanol and ethanol used in fluid bed granulation)

blocks.zh: 防止不同產品間的氣味交叉影響
blocks.en: Prevent odor cross-influence between different products

blocks.zh: 保護操作人員免受低濃度有害蒸氣暴露
blocks.en: Protect operators from exposure to low concentrations of hazardous vapors

blocks.zh: 8.1.12-8.1.15 Ductwork, Damper, Diffuser, UV Light（風管、風門、散流器、紫外光）
blocks.en: 8.1.12-8.1.15 Ductwork, Damper, Diffuser, UV Light

blocks.zh: 重點提示：UV 燈在藥廠 HVAC 中「幾乎無價值」
blocks.en: Key Point: UV Lamps Have "Almost No Value" in Pharmaceutical HVAC

blocks.zh: ISPE 的立場很明確：UV 燈在製藥 HVAC 中價值有限。原因是：
blocks.en: ISPE's position is clear: UV lamps are of limited value in pharmaceutical HVAC. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: 風管內風速太高（通常 5-15 m/s），微生物通過 UV 照射區的時間太短
blocks.en: Air velocity in the duct is too high (typically 5-15 m/s), so microorganisms spend too little time in the UV irradiation zone

blocks.zh: 要達到有效殺菌劑量，需要極高的 UV 能量密度——不經濟
blocks.en: Achieving an effective germicidal dose requires a very high UV energy density, which is uneconomical

blocks.zh: 即使搭配過濾器增加暴露時間，效果也有限
blocks.en: Even with filters added to increase exposure time, the effect is limited

blocks.zh: 藥廠的微生物控制應依靠 HEPA 過濾和壓差控制，而非 UV 燈。
blocks.en: Microbial control in a pharmaceutical plant should rely on HEPA filtration and differential pressure control, not UV lamps.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：為什麼藥廠推薦金屬風管？
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Is Metal Ductwork Recommended for Pharmaceutical Plants?

blocks.zh: ISPE 推薦金屬風管（Metal Ductwork），原因包括：
blocks.en: ISPE recommends Metal Ductwork for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 不會釋放纖維——玻璃纖維板風管會釋放纖維微粒
blocks.en: It does not shed fibers: fiberglass duct board releases fiber particles

blocks.zh: 內壁光滑——易清潔，減少微粒和微生物附著
blocks.en: Smooth interior walls: easy to clean, reducing adhesion of particles and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 耐用——不會因清潔劑或消毒劑而劣化
blocks.en: Durable: does not degrade with cleaning agents or disinfectants

blocks.zh: 不吸潮——塑膠或玻璃纖維材料可能吸收水分
blocks.en: Does not absorb moisture: plastic or fiberglass materials may absorb water

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Grille、Register、Diffuser 的區別
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Difference Between Grille, Register and Diffuser

blocks.zh: 這三個英文詞在中文常常混用，但定義不同：
blocks.en: In Chinese these three English terms are often used interchangeably, but they are defined differently:

blocks.zh: 在潔淨室中，Non-Aspirating Diffuser（非吸引式散流器）特別重要——它提供等速向下的氣流，最小化混合，適用於需要單向流或低混合度的場所（如 HEPA 過濾器面板）。
blocks.en: In a cleanroom, the Non-Aspirating Diffuser is particularly important: it provides uniform downward airflow with minimal mixing, and suits places needing unidirectional flow or low mixing (such as HEPA filter panels).

blocks.zh: Table 8.1: System Components and Their Influence on Environmental Parameters（系統元件與環境參數影響矩陣）
blocks.en: Table 8.1: System Components and Their Influence on Environmental Parameters

blocks.zh: 核心概念：如何閱讀這張矩陣？
blocks.en: Core Concept: How to Read This Matrix

blocks.zh: 這張表是理解 HVAC 系統設計的「速查表」——每個元件影響哪些環境參數，一目了然。
blocks.en: This table is the "cheat sheet" for understanding HVAC system design: which environmental parameters each component influences is clear at a glance.

blocks.zh: 關鍵觀察：
blocks.en: Key observations:

blocks.zh: Air Handler（AHU）是唯一影響所有五個參數的設備——這就是為什麼它是系統的核心
blocks.en: The Air Handler (AHU) is the only equipment that affects all five parameters, which is why it is the core of the system

blocks.zh: Cooling Coil同時影響溫度和濕度——它是 AHU 中最「多功能」的元件
blocks.en: The Cooling Coil affects both temperature and humidity, making it the most "multi-functional" component in the AHU

blocks.zh: Air Filter只影響 Air Cleanliness——但這是 GMP 最關鍵的參數
blocks.en: The Air Filter affects only Air Cleanliness, but that is the most critical parameter for GMP

blocks.zh: 風管和風門影響壓力和風量——它們是「輸送系統」，不做空氣調節
blocks.en: Ductwork and dampers affect pressure and airflow: they are the "delivery system" and do not condition the air

blocks.zh: 如果一間潔淨室的溫度偏高但濕度正常，問題最可能出在哪個元件？如果溫度正常但濕度偏高呢？
blocks.en: If the temperature in a cleanroom is high but the humidity is normal, which component is the most likely cause of the problem? What if the temperature is normal but the humidity is high?

blocks.zh: 使用這張表，設計一個「最小化」的 HVAC 系統（只需控制壓差和空氣潔淨度），需要哪些元件？
blocks.en: Using this table, design a "minimal" HVAC system (controlling only differential pressure and air cleanliness). Which components are needed?

blocks.zh: 8.2 HVAC System Configuration / 8.2.2 Number of Air Handling Units（HVAC 系統配置 / AHU 數量決策）
blocks.en: 8.2 HVAC System Configuration / 8.2.2 Number of Air Handling Units (Deciding the Number of AHUs)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的特殊考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Special Considerations for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於多產品 CDMO 來說，AHU 分區設計直接影響營運彈性：
blocks.en: For a multi-product CDMO, how the AHUs are zoned directly affects operational flexibility:

blocks.zh: 交叉污染控制：不同客戶的產品不應共用 AHU——即使有 HEPA 過濾，法規和客戶稽查都會質疑
blocks.en: Cross-contamination control: products of different clients should not share an AHU; even with HEPA filtration, regulators and client audits will question it

blocks.zh: 同時生產（Concurrent Manufacturing）：ISPE 明確指出多台 AHU 可以更容易實現多產品同時生產
blocks.en: Concurrent Manufacturing: ISPE states explicitly that multiple AHUs make it easier to achieve concurrent manufacturing of multiple products

blocks.zh: 產品特性差異：一些產品需要低濕度、一些需要密閉排氣——不同 AHU 可以獨立設定
blocks.en: Product-specific differences: some products need low humidity, others need contained exhaust; separate AHUs can be set independently

blocks.zh: 決策原則：以「產品風險和操作人員風險」為基礎——這符合 ICH Q9 風險管理的精神
blocks.en: Decision principle: base the decision on "product risk and operator risk", which is consistent with the spirit of ICH Q9 risk management

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在規劃新廠房，有三條產線：口服固體劑型、無菌充填、高活性 API 製劑。最佳 AHU 分區策略：
blocks.en: A CDMO is planning a new facility with three production lines: oral solid dosage, aseptic filling and highly potent API formulation. The best AHU zoning strategy:

blocks.zh: 無菌充填區：獨立 AHU + 全新風或高效回風過濾
blocks.en: Aseptic filling area: dedicated AHU + once-through air or high-efficiency filtered recirculation

blocks.zh: 高活性 API 製劑區：獨立 AHU + 全排氣（Once-Through）+ 排氣處理
blocks.en: Highly potent API formulation area: dedicated AHU + full exhaust (Once-Through) + exhaust treatment

blocks.zh: 口服固體劑型區：可分為壓片、包衣、包裝等子區域，每區獨立 AHU
blocks.en: Oral solid dosage area: can be divided into sub-areas such as compression, coating and packaging, each with its own AHU

blocks.zh: 每增加一台 AHU 雖然增加初始和維護成本，但降低的交叉污染風險和增加的營運彈性在 CDMO 商業模式中價值更大。
blocks.en: Each additional AHU increases initial and maintenance cost, but in the CDMO business model the reduced cross-contamination risk and increased operational flexibility are worth more.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AHU 分區——多台小機 vs. 一台大機
blocks.en: Core Concept: AHU Zoning - Several Small Units vs. One Large Unit

blocks.zh: 這是 HVAC 設計的第一個重大決策。ISPE 的分析框架：
blocks.en: This is the first major decision in HVAC design. ISPE's analysis framework:

blocks.zh: 8.2.3 Basic System Types（基本系統類型）
blocks.en: 8.2.3 Basic System Types

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：三種系統就像三種通風方式
blocks.en: Analogy: Three System Types Are Like Three Ways of Ventilating

blocks.zh: Once-Through（全新風）= 開著所有窗戶 + 排風扇：新鮮空氣不斷進來，但冷暖氣全部吹走，電費驚人
blocks.en: Once-Through (100% fresh air) = all the windows open + an exhaust fan: fresh air keeps coming in, but all the heating and cooling is blown away, and the electricity bill is huge

blocks.zh: Recirculated（再循環）= 一般家用冷氣：大部分空氣在室內循環，只補充少量外氣，最省能源
blocks.en: Recirculated = an ordinary household air conditioner: most of the air circulates indoors and only a little outside air is added, the most energy-efficient option

blocks.zh: Exhaust（排氣）= 廚房抽油煙機：只把髒空氣抽走，靠門窗縫隙吸入周圍空氣
blocks.en: Exhaust = a kitchen range hood: it only extracts the dirty air and draws in surrounding air through gaps around doors and windows

blocks.zh: 實際藥廠通常是組合使用——潔淨區用再循環系統（省能源），高危害區用全新風（安全），局部用排氣系統（捕捉污染物）。
blocks.en: Actual pharmaceutical plants usually use a combination: recirculated systems for clean areas (saving energy), once-through for high-hazard areas (safety), and local exhaust systems (capturing contaminants).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Once-Through 系統的隱藏成本
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hidden Cost of Once-Through Systems

blocks.zh: 全新風系統在熱帶氣候（如台灣、東南亞）特別昂貴：
blocks.en: Once-through systems are particularly expensive in tropical climates (such as Taiwan and Southeast Asia):

blocks.zh: 夏天外氣 35°C / 80% RH → 需要大量冷卻和除濕能力
blocks.en: Summer outdoor air at 35°C / 80% RH → requires large cooling and dehumidification capacity

blocks.zh: 冬天外氣乾燥 → 可能需要加濕
blocks.en: Dry winter outdoor air → may require humidification

blocks.zh: 全年外氣含大量微粒 → 預過濾器更換頻率大增
blocks.en: Outdoor air carries a large particle load all year round → pre-filters must be replaced far more often

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議：如果使用全新風，Energy Recovery（能量回收）通常是合理的——可回收排氣中 50-80% 的能量。
blocks.en: ISPE recommends: if once-through air is used, Energy Recovery is usually justified, since it can recover 50-80% of the energy in the exhaust air.

blocks.zh: 8.2.3.4-8.2.4 AHU Parallel/Series & Blow-Through vs. Draw-Through（AHU 串並聯 & 吹入式 vs. 抽入式）
blocks.en: 8.2.3.4-8.2.4 AHU Parallel/Series & Blow-Through vs. Draw-Through

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：串聯 AHU 就像兩段式淨水
blocks.en: Analogy: AHUs in Series Are Like Two-Stage Water Purification

blocks.zh: 串聯 AHU 特別適合熱帶地區（如台灣）：一台中央 AHU 先處理外氣的高溫高濕（預調節），再把預處理過的空氣分配給下游各區域的 AHU 做精密調節。就像淨水系統先用大型前處理設備去除大部分雜質，再讓各樓層的小型淨水器做最後精製。
blocks.en: AHUs in series are especially suitable for tropical regions (such as Taiwan): one central AHU first handles the high temperature and humidity of the outside air (pre-conditioning), and then distributes the pre-treated air to the downstream AHUs of each area for fine conditioning. It is like a water purification system that first uses large pre-treatment equipment to remove most impurities, and then lets small purifiers on each floor do the final polishing.

blocks.zh: 好處：下游 AHU 不需要處理極端的外氣條件，設備可以更小、控制更精準。
blocks.en: Benefit: the downstream AHUs do not have to deal with extreme outside air conditions, so the equipment can be smaller and the control more precise.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：並聯冗餘設計的 70% 法則
blocks.en: Key Point: The 70% Rule for Parallel Redundancy Design

blocks.zh: ISPE 的範例很經典：兩台各 50% 容量的風機並聯，一台故障時另一台可以提供 70%（而非 50%）的設計風量。原因：風管阻力與風量的平方成正比，風量減少時阻力大幅下降，單台風機的工作點往高風量方向移動。
blocks.en: ISPE's example is a classic: two fans, each sized for 50% capacity, run in parallel; when one fails, the other can deliver 70% (not 50%) of the design airflow. The reason: duct resistance is proportional to the square of airflow, so when the flow drops, resistance falls sharply and the operating point of the single fan moves toward higher airflow.

blocks.zh: 這個概念對 CDMO 特別重要——可以在不完全停產的情況下維持基本的環境控制。
blocks.en: This concept is especially important for a CDMO: basic environmental control can be maintained without a complete production shutdown.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Drain Trap 乾涸是隱形風險
blocks.en: Key Point: A Dried-Out Drain Trap Is a Hidden Risk

blocks.zh: 排水陷阱（Drain Trap）乾涸看似小事，但在 Draw-Through 系統中會讓未經過濾的外部空氣被吸入 AHU——直接繞過所有過濾系統。預防措施：
blocks.en: A dried-out Drain Trap seems a minor matter, but in a Draw-Through system it lets unfiltered outside air be drawn into the AHU, bypassing all the filtration. Preventive measures:

blocks.zh: 設計自動補水裝置
blocks.en: Design an automatic water make-up device

blocks.zh: 定期巡檢確認水封完整
blocks.en: Inspect regularly to confirm the water seal is intact

blocks.zh: 陷阱高度要足夠抵抗系統負壓
blocks.en: The trap height must be sufficient to resist the negative pressure in the system

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Blow-Through vs. Draw-Through
blocks.en: Core Concept: Blow-Through vs. Draw-Through

blocks.zh: Draw-Through 是藥廠更常見的選擇——體積小、風機自帶再熱功能可保護 HEPA。但要注意排水陷阱（Drain Trap）的設計。
blocks.en: Draw-Through is the more common choice in pharmaceutical plants: it is compact, and the fan's own reheat effect helps protect the HEPA filters. Attention must be paid to the design of the Drain Trap.

blocks.zh: 8.3 Pressure Control Strategies（壓差控制策略）
blocks.en: 8.3 Pressure Control Strategies

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓差 vs. 氣流方向——選擇依據
blocks.en: Core Concept: Differential Pressure vs. Airflow Direction - the Basis for Choosing

blocks.zh: ISPE 將壓差控制分為兩個層次：
blocks.en: ISPE divides pressure control into two levels:

blocks.zh: 分級空間（Classified Spaces）：必須有可量測的壓差（Measurable DP）——10-15 Pa
blocks.en: Classified Spaces: must have a Measurable DP - 10-15 Pa

blocks.zh: 非分級空間（Non-Classified）：可以用氣流方向代替壓差量測——透過煙霧測試（Smoke Test）或風量差計算驗證
blocks.en: Non-Classified spaces: airflow direction can replace differential pressure measurement, verified through a smoke test or calculation of airflow differences

blocks.zh: 關鍵數據：保持微粒不通過開口的氣流速度只需 0.5-1 m/s，對應的壓差 < 1 Pa。但現有壓差感測器精度約 +/- 1.2 Pa，所以非分級空間的最低壓差建議至少 2 Pa，更常見 5 Pa。
blocks.en: Key data: the air velocity needed to keep particles from passing through an opening is only 0.5-1 m/s, corresponding to a differential pressure of < 1 Pa. However, the accuracy of available pressure sensors is about +/- 1.2 Pa, so the minimum differential pressure for non-classified spaces is recommended to be at least 2 Pa, and more commonly 5 Pa.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：「不需要自動壓差控制」——但有條件
blocks.en: Key Point: "Automatic Pressure Control Is Not Required" - but with Conditions

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：GMP 並不要求自動壓差控制。「靜態平衡（Static Air Balance）」——在 Commissioning 時手動調好風量——在藥廠中很常見且成功。但前提是：
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly: GMP does not require automatic pressure control. "Static Air Balance", in which airflows are set manually at commissioning, is common and successful in pharmaceutical plants. The prerequisites are:

blocks.zh: 送風量恆定（HEPA 負載緩慢，有預過濾器保護）
blocks.en: Constant supply airflow (HEPA loading is slow, with pre-filters providing protection)

blocks.zh: 沒有開關式排氣系統
blocks.en: No on/off exhaust systems

blocks.zh: 門封和傳遞窗維護良好，洩漏量恆定
blocks.en: Door seals and pass boxes are well maintained, so leakage is constant

blocks.zh: 如果這些條件不成立（例如有粉塵處理排氣的開關），就可能需要自動控制。
blocks.en: If these conditions are not met (for example, there are switched exhausts for dust handling), automatic control may be needed.

blocks.zh: 一間口服固體劑型的壓片間，不需要分級，但需要防止粉塵擴散到走廊。你會用壓差控制還是氣流方向控制？為什麼？
blocks.en: A tablet compression room for oral solid dosage does not need to be classified, but must prevent dust from spreading to the corridor. Would you use differential pressure control or airflow direction control? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「靜態平衡」在 HEPA 過濾器剛換和快換時的壓差表現不同？這對維護計畫有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why does the differential pressure under "static balance" behave differently when the HEPA filters are newly changed and when they are about to be changed? What does this imply for the maintenance plan?

blocks.zh: 8.3.3 Airlocks（氣鎖室）
blocks.en: 8.3.3 Airlocks

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：門的物理學
blocks.en: Analogy: The Physics of Doors

blocks.zh: 開門 vs. 關門的空氣需求差異驚人：
blocks.en: The airflow needed with a door open versus closed differs enormously:

blocks.zh: 2 m2 的開門：需要 3,500 m3/hr 的氣流才能阻擋微粒通過
blocks.en: A 2 m2 open door: needs 3,500 m3/hr of airflow to prevent particles passing through

blocks.zh: 同尺寸的關門：只需 160 m3/hr 通過門縫即可——差了 20 倍以上！
blocks.en: The same size door closed: needs only 160 m3/hr through the gaps around the door, a difference of more than 20 times!

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼氣鎖室的門互鎖（Interlocking）如此重要——EU GMP Annex 1 對無菌設施已經是強制要求。如果兩扇門同時打開，等於失去了壓差屏障。
blocks.en: This is why airlock door Interlocking is so important; it is already mandatory for sterile facilities under EU GMP Annex 1. If both doors are open at the same time, the pressure barrier is lost.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Bubble vs. Sink 的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Logic for Choosing Between Bubble and Sink

blocks.zh: 當同時需要潔淨分級和產品密閉時：
blocks.en: When both cleanliness classification and product containment are required:

blocks.zh: 進入時（更衣、物料進入）→ 使用 Pressure Bubble（正壓）：氣鎖內的空氣向兩側洩漏，防止外部污染進入，也防止內部危害物質洩出
blocks.en: On entry (gowning, material entry) → use a Pressure Bubble (positive pressure): air in the airlock leaks to both sides, preventing outside contamination from entering and also preventing internal hazardous material from escaping

blocks.zh: 退出時（脫衣、物料消毒退出）→ 使用 Pressure Sink（負壓）：氣鎖內的空氣被抽走，任何從房間帶出的污染物都被吸住
blocks.en: On exit (de-gowning, material exit after disinfection) → use a Pressure Sink (negative pressure): air in the airlock is drawn away, and any contaminants carried out of the room are captured

blocks.zh: Bubble 的潔淨等級應與它服務的較潔淨房間相同——因為 Bubble 的空氣會洩漏進入那間潔淨室。
blocks.en: The cleanliness grade of the Bubble should be the same as that of the cleaner room it serves, because the Bubble air leaks into that cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 有一間 Grade B（ISO 7）無菌充填室，操作高活性 API。需要同時保護產品（潔淨）和操作人員（密閉）。氣鎖設計：
blocks.en: A CDMO has a Grade B (ISO 7) aseptic filling room handling highly potent API. Both the product (cleanliness) and the operators (containment) need protection. The airlock design:

blocks.zh: 人員更衣氣鎖（進入側）：Pressure Bubble，壓力高於 Grade B 室 5-8 Pa，Grade B 等級
blocks.en: Personnel gowning airlock (entry side): Pressure Bubble, 5-8 Pa higher than the Grade B room, Grade B classification

blocks.zh: 人員脫衣氣鎖（退出側）：Pressure Sink，壓力低於兩側 5-8 Pa，配備排氣處理
blocks.en: Personnel de-gowning airlock (exit side): Pressure Sink, 5-8 Pa lower than both adjacent sides, equipped with exhaust treatment

blocks.zh: 物料傳遞窗：HEPA 通風，從 Grade B 側向外梯級壓差
blocks.en: Material pass-through hatch: HEPA-ventilated, with a cascade pressure differential outward from the Grade B side

blocks.zh: 所有門配備互鎖系統——Annex 1 強制要求
blocks.en: All doors are equipped with an interlock system, which is mandatory under Annex 1

blocks.zh: 8.3.4-8.3.5 Determining DP & Air Leakage / DP Measurement（壓差與空氣洩漏計算 / 壓差量測）
blocks.en: 8.3.4-8.3.5 Determining DP & Air Leakage / DP Measurement

blocks.zh: 核心概念：壓差設計的關鍵數據
blocks.en: Core Concept: Key Data for Differential Pressure Design

blocks.zh: ISPE 提供了非常具體的壓差設計指引：
blocks.en: ISPE provides very specific guidance on differential pressure design:

blocks.zh: 不同潔淨等級之間：10-15 Pa（透過氣鎖量測）
blocks.en: Between different cleanliness grades: 10-15 Pa (measured across the airlock)

blocks.zh: 相同等級不同房間：最低 1.5 Pa 可運作，設計目標至少 5 Pa
blocks.en: Between rooms of the same grade: a minimum of 1.5 Pa can work, with a design target of at least 5 Pa

blocks.zh: 非分級空間：至少 2 Pa（超過感測器精度）
blocks.en: Non-classified spaces: at least 2 Pa (above the sensor accuracy)

blocks.zh: 門縫設計假設：側面和頂部 3 mm，底部 7-15 mm——這些「小數字」決定了整個房間的洩漏風量計算。
blocks.en: Door gap design assumptions: 3 mm at the sides and top, 7-15 mm at the bottom; these "small numbers" determine the whole room's leakage airflow calculation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：洩漏計算不能用「百分比法」
blocks.en: Key Point: Leakage Calculation Must Not Use the "Percentage Method"

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確反對用「供氣量的 X%」作為洩漏估算——這是業界常見的偷懶做法。正確方法是基於：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly opposes estimating leakage as "X% of supply air", a shortcut common in industry. The correct method is based on:

blocks.zh: 已知的建築結構（門數量、門縫尺寸、傳遞窗數量）
blocks.en: The known building construction (number of doors, door gap dimensions, number of pass boxes)

blocks.zh: 設計壓差值
blocks.en: The design differential pressure values

blocks.zh: ASHRAE Handbook 的計算公式（見 Appendix 1）
blocks.en: The ASHRAE Handbook calculation formulas (see Appendix 1)

blocks.zh: 百分比法的風險：可能嚴重低估或高估——低估導致壓差不足，高估導致能源浪費和 AHU 過大。
blocks.en: The risk of the percentage method: it can badly underestimate or overestimate leakage; underestimating leads to insufficient differential pressure, and overestimating leads to wasted energy and an oversized AHU.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種壓差量測方法
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Methods of Measuring Differential Pressure

blocks.zh: Room-to-Room（房間對房間）：適合小型簡單設施，直接量測最關鍵的壓差關係。
blocks.en: Room-to-Room: suited to small, simple facilities, measuring the most critical pressure relationships directly.

blocks.zh: Room-to-Common Reference（房間對共用參考點）：適合大型設施，減少感測器數量和累積誤差。參考點應選在壓力穩定的位置（如機械設備間、技術夾層）。
blocks.en: Room-to-Common Reference: suited to large facilities, reducing the number of sensors and the accumulation of error. The reference point should be located where the pressure is stable (such as a mechanical equipment room or technical interstitial space).

blocks.zh: 注意：戶外壓力作為參考點在理論上很直覺，但實際上因天氣影響很難穩定——不建議使用。
blocks.en: Note: using outdoor pressure as a reference point is intuitive in theory, but in practice it is hard to keep stable because of the weather, so it is not recommended.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GEP——送風規格嚴、回風規格寬
blocks.en: Key Point: GEP - Tight Specification for Supply Air, Wider for Return Air

blocks.zh: ISPE 提出一個實用的工程原則：送風量應有嚴格的規格，回風量應有較寬的設計範圍。原因：
blocks.en: ISPE offers a practical engineering principle: supply airflow should have a tight specification, and return airflow a wider design range. The reasons:

blocks.zh: 送風量直接決定房間的潔淨度和溫濕度——必須精確
blocks.en: Supply airflow directly determines the room's cleanliness, temperature and humidity, so it must be precise

blocks.zh: 回風量 = 送風量 - 洩漏量，但實際洩漏量與計算值可能有差距
blocks.en: Return airflow = supply airflow - leakage, but actual leakage may differ from the calculated value

blocks.zh: 回風管通常設計為送風量的 50-80%，留有餘量應對實際洩漏偏低的情況
blocks.en: Return ducts are usually designed for 50-80% of the supply airflow, leaving margin for the case where actual leakage is lower than expected

blocks.zh: 8.4 Ventilation Strategies / 8.4.1 Room Air Supply Distribution（通風策略 / 房間送風分配）
blocks.en: 8.4 Ventilation Strategies / 8.4.1 Room Air Supply Distribution

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：泳池的兩種清潔方式
blocks.en: Analogy: Two Ways of Cleaning a Swimming Pool

blocks.zh: Dilution（稀釋）就像在髒水池中不斷加入乾淨水——髒水被稀釋，整池水逐漸變乾淨，但永遠不可能完全乾淨。加水越快，水越乾淨。
blocks.en: Dilution is like continuously adding clean water to a dirty pool: the dirty water is diluted and the whole pool gradually gets cleaner, but it can never become completely clean. The faster you add water, the cleaner it gets.

blocks.zh: Displacement（置換）就像從泳池的一端推入乾淨水，把髒水從另一端擠出去——乾淨水和髒水之間有明確的界線。這就是 ISO 5 單向流的原理。
blocks.en: Displacement is like pushing clean water in at one end of the pool and forcing the dirty water out at the other: there is a clear boundary between the clean and dirty water. This is the principle of ISO 5 unidirectional flow.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Grade 7 (ISO 7) 的關鍵分界線
blocks.en: Key Point: The Critical Dividing Line at Grade 7 (ISO 7)

blocks.zh: ISPE 指出 Dilution 方式最高可接受到 Grade 7（EU Grade B），這是一個重要的設計分界線：
blocks.en: ISPE points out that Dilution is acceptable up to Grade 7 (EU Grade B), an important design dividing line:

blocks.zh: Grade 7 及以下：Dilution + Non-Aspirating Diffuser + 部分 HEPA 覆蓋
blocks.en: Grade 7 and below: Dilution + Non-Aspirating Diffuser + partial HEPA coverage

blocks.zh: Grade 5：必須 Displacement + 接近 100% HEPA 天花板覆蓋 + 低位回風
blocks.en: Grade 5: must be Displacement + close to 100% HEPA ceiling coverage + low-level return

blocks.zh: Grade 6：介於兩者之間，多個天花板送風口，但覆蓋率低於 100%
blocks.en: Grade 6: in between, with multiple ceiling supply outlets but less than 100% coverage

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，理解這個分界線直接影響設施設計成本和營運效率。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, understanding this dividing line directly affects facility design cost and operating efficiency.

blocks.zh: 一間 Grade 7 背景區（EU Grade B）採用 Dilution 送風。如果需要在同一房間內設置 Grade 5 的局部區域（RABS 或 Isolator），送風策略應如何調整？
blocks.en: A Grade 7 background area (EU Grade B) uses Dilution supply. If a local Grade 5 zone (RABS or Isolator) must be set up in the same room, how should the supply air strategy be adjusted?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISPE 說 Dilution 方式「也適合處理可能飛揚的粉塵的場所」？Displacement 方式處理粉塵有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does ISPE say the Dilution approach is "also suitable for places where dust may become airborne"? What problems does the Displacement approach have in handling dust?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: AHU 組成：金屬箱體 + 風機 + 加熱/冷卻盤管 + 過濾器 + 加濕/除濕器，是 HVAC 的核心設備，影響所有五大環境參數
blocks.en: AHU components: metal casing + fan + heating/cooling coils + filters + humidifier/dehumidifier; the core equipment of HVAC, affecting all five environmental parameters

blocks.zh: 盤管系統：Preheat Coil 防凍保護；Cooling Coil 兼做除濕（注意 Mist Eliminator 和排水）；Reheat Coil 用於除濕後再加熱；Re-cool Coil 用於乾燥劑後降溫
blocks.en: Coil systems: Preheat Coil for freeze protection; Cooling Coil also dehumidifies (mind the Mist Eliminator and drainage); Reheat Coil for reheating after dehumidification; Re-cool Coil for cooling after the desiccant

blocks.zh: 加濕器水源：Clean Steam 浪費、Re-boiler 蒸汽推薦、Plant Steam 只限非生產區；閒置時微生物風險不可忽略
blocks.en: Humidifier water source: Clean Steam is wasteful, Re-boiler steam is recommended, Plant Steam is limited to non-production areas; the microbial risk when idle cannot be ignored

blocks.zh: 除濕兩階段：冷卻盤管除濕到 30-40% RH → 乾燥劑除濕到更低（兩者串聯最經濟）
blocks.en: Two-stage dehumidification: cooling coil dehumidification to 30-40% RH → desiccant dehumidification to lower levels (the two in series is the most economical)

blocks.zh: 過濾層級：Pre-filter → Intermediate → Final (95% DOP/HEPA) → Terminal HEPA，每層保護下一層
blocks.en: Filtration hierarchy: Pre-filter → Intermediate → Final (95% DOP/HEPA) → Terminal HEPA, each layer protecting the next

blocks.zh: 三種系統類型：Once-Through（高安全、高能耗）、Recirculated（經濟主流）、Exhaust（輔助用途）
blocks.en: Three system types: Once-Through (high safety, high energy use), Recirculated (the economical mainstream), Exhaust (supporting use)

blocks.zh: AHU 配置：Draw-Through 較常見（自帶再熱保護 HEPA），Blow-Through 適合高熱負荷場景
blocks.en: AHU configuration: Draw-Through is more common (its own reheat protects the HEPA); Blow-Through suits high heat load scenarios

blocks.zh: 壓差控制：分級空間 10-15 Pa；同級別房間設計目標 ≥ 5 Pa；靜態平衡在條件滿足時可行，不一定需要自動控制
blocks.en: Pressure control: classified spaces 10-15 Pa; design target for rooms of the same grade ≥ 5 Pa; static balance is workable when the conditions are met, and automatic control is not always needed

blocks.zh: 氣鎖三配置：Cascade（單一需求）、Bubble（正壓，乾淨操作進入側）、Sink（負壓，污染操作退出側）；門互鎖是 Annex 1 強制要求
blocks.en: Three airlock configurations: Cascade (single requirement), Bubble (positive pressure, clean operation, entry side), Sink (negative pressure, contaminating operation, exit side); door interlocking is mandatory under Annex 1

blocks.zh: 送風分配：Dilution 適用到 Grade 7（稀釋混合），Displacement 用於 Grade 5（單向流置換）——潔淨等級決定選擇
blocks.en: Supply air distribution: Dilution applies up to Grade 7 (dilution mixing), Displacement is used for Grade 5 (unidirectional displacement); the cleanliness grade determines the choice
